orwell.definition: n. imaginative British writer concerned with social justice (1903-1950)

orwellian.definition: a. of or relating to the works of George Orwell (especially his picture of a future totalitarian state)
orwellian.translation: George Orwell的笔调或用字的, 受严格统治而失去人性的社会, 赞成上述社会的人

orwellism.translation: n. 奥威尔主义(指为达到宣传目的而篡改并歪曲事实)
